y-m-25-08.title: Tinogona kuvimba ne equation y=−5x+200 kusvika rini?
y-m-25-08.topic: Range apo linear function model inoshanda: kana mamiriro achichinja, equation inochinjawo
y-m-25-08.goal: Tarisa range nemamiriro apo linear function equation inoshanda, uye unzwisise kuti equation inogona kuchinja kana mamiriro achichinja, uchigadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva.
y-m-25-08.material: Kana ukavhura drain valve yetangi rine mvura 200 L, mvura inoerera pa 5 L paminetsi. Taura nguva yekuvhurwa kwevalve se 0 maminetsi, uye huwandu hwemvura yakasara mutangi mushure me x maminetsi ngahuve y L. Tarisa kubva ku 0 maminetsi kusvika ku 60 maminetsi. Mvura iri mutangi haigone kudzika pasi pe 0 L.
y-m-25-08.thinking.0: Kuwana kana mutengo we expression une musoro mumamiriro
y-m-25-08.thinking.2: Kupatsanura mamiriro uye kuisa model zvakare
y-m-25-08.prereq.0: Kuisa mutengo we x mu linear function y=ax+b kuwana y
y-m-25-08.prereq.1: Zvinoreva kana y ichidzikira nekuti slope i negative
y-m-25-08.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa mamiriro emvura ichiererera mutangi apo ruzivo rwunowedzerwa rumwe pachimwe. Padanho rimwe nerimwe, sarudza pfungwa yakakodzera zvikuru.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mutengo wa x kuwana y, wobva watarisa kana mutengo uyu une musoro mumamiriro.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.hint.1: Patsanura nguva panguva apo mamiriro akachinja.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Ayo i mamiriro ekutanga. Valve inochengetwa yakavhurika, uye huwandu hwemvura yakasara hunotaurwa se y = −5x + 200 (0 ≤ x ≤ 40).
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mvura yakasara mutangi mushure memaminetsi 30 i yakadini?
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.after: y = −5×30 + 200 = 50 L. I mutengo uri mukati merange apo equation inoshanda (0 ≤ x ≤ 40).
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaisa nguva muequation uye wakawana huwandu hwakasara.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hauna kuona kuti kukosha kunogona kutsvakwa kunyange chirevo chakapiwa.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana ukaisa x = 50 muchirevo, y = −50 inobuda. Asi tangi iri rinodonha rose uye rinova risina chinhu mushure memaminiti 40.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Chirevo chinogona kuverengwa, asi mumamiriro mvura haigoni kuva shoma pa 0 L. Mhando iyo chirevo chinovimbika ndi 0 ≤ x ≤ 40.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Mushure memaminiti 50 mune −50 L yemvura mutangi
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Nokuda kwekukosha kumwe kunze kwemhando, wakarasa kunyange kukosha kuri mukati memhando.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Chirevo chinowirirana nemamiriro kusvika maminiti 40 chete, uye mushure meizvozvo mvura yasara ndi 0 L
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatarisa mhando iyo chirevo chinoshanda nomuganho wemamiriro pamwe chete.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Iri ruzivo rutsva. Maneja akavhara vharuvhu pamaminiti 20 uye akaivhura zvakare pamaminiti 25 (kukurumidza kwokudonha shure kwokuvhurwa zvakare kwakafanana).
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mvura yasara mutangi mushure memaminiti 30 ndeyakadini? 50 L yawakatanga kuwana inofanira kugadziriswa sei?
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Pamaminiti 20 pasara 100 L, uye inoramba yakadaro kusvika pamaminiti 25. Kubva pamaminiti 25 inodonha 5 L panguva imwe, saka pamaminiti 30 ndi 100 − 25 = 75 L.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 50 L: chirevo y = −5x + 200 chinogona kushandiswa kubva pakutanga kusvika pakupedzisira
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakafunga kuti chirevo chekutanga chinoramba chakarurama kunyange mamiriro achichinja.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 100 L: shure kwokuvharwa, hapana inodonha zvakare
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 25 L: mvura yakadonha mumaminiti 5 aya yakavharwa zvakare
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti mvura yakadonha kunyange pakavharwa.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 75 L: 25 L isina kudonha mumaminiti 5 apo vharuvhu yakavharwa inoramba yakawedzera
y-m-25-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakaverenga kuti yakadonha shoma nenguva yakavharwa.
y-m-25-08.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga wakawana kukosha pamaminiti 30 nechirevo zvakarurama, asi shure kwokuchinja kwemamiriro, chirevo chimwe chete hachichaenderani. Unofanira kutarisa kuti chirevo chakagadzirwa pasi pemamiriro api uye kana mamiriro iwayo achiramba achishanda.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.prompt: Vharuvhu yakavharwa pamaminiti 20 uye yakavhurwa zvakare pamaminiti 25 (kukurumidza kwokudonha kwakafanana). Isa nguva 3 dzakasiyana x maminiti apo huwandu chaihwo hwemvura yasara hwakasiyana nokukosha kwechirevo y = −5x + 200, pamwe chete nemvura yasara y L panguva iyoyo, se (x, y). Asi, 20 < x ≤ 60.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora nenhevedzano mvura yasara pamaminiti 20, maminiti 25, nemaminiti 30.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga zvakasiyana chete nguva iyo mvura yakadonha chaizvo.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.fail.c1: x haina kukura kupfuura 20 uye ndi 60 kana kushoma.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu chaihwo hwemvura yasara panguva iyoyo.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Hahusi huwandu chaihwo hwemvura yasara panguva iyoyo. Paradzanisa nguva kuva apo vharuvhu yakavhurwa nokuvharwa.
y-m-25-08.s.s2.explain: Kubva pamaminiti 20 kusvika pa 25 inoramba iri 100 L. Kubva pamaminiti 25 ndi y = 100 − 5(x − 25) = 225 − 5x, uye kana ichipera pamaminiti 45, shure kwaizvozvo ndi 0 L. Shure kwamaminiti 20, kukosha kunosiyana nechirevo chekutanga.

y-m-25-06.title: Kana ma area akafanana, ma slope akafananawo here?
y-m-25-06.topic: Triangle yakavharwa negraph ye linear function nemaaxes maviri: area imwechete, ma slope akasiyana
y-m-25-06.goal: Raira generalization yekuti 'kana ma area akafanana, ma slope akafanana' ne counterexample, uye uwane kuti mhedziso inochinja sei kana mamiriro achichinjwa.
y-m-25-06.material: Pa coordinate plane pane mutsetse une x-intercept a uye y-intercept b (a ne b i nhamba dzisiri 0). Mutsetse uyu unopfuura mapoinzi (a, 0) ne (0, b) uye unoumba triangle pamwe chete ne x-axis ne y-axis. Area yetriangle iyi i hafu yeproduct ye absolute value ye a ne absolute value ye b. Hyeonu anoti, 'Mitsetse inoumba ma triangle ane area imwechete nemaaxes maviri ine slope imwechetewo.'
y-m-25-06.prereq.0: Zvinoreva x-intercept, y-intercept, ne slope mugraph ye linear function
y-m-25-06.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuedza kana chirevo chaHyeonu chekuti 'mitsetse inoumba ma triangle ane area imwechete nemaaxes maviri ine slope imwechetewo' chakarurama nguva dzose. Ndeipi mitsetse miviri yaunofanira kuwana kuratidza kuti chirevo ichi chakaipa?
y-m-25-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakaparadzana 'mamiriro' (ma area akafanana) ne 'mhedziso' (ma slope akafanana) muchirevo chaHyeonu.
y-m-25-06.s.s1.hint.1: Taura kuti muenzaniso unochengeta mamiriro asi unoputsa mhedziso waizoita sei.
y-m-25-06.s.s1.o.a: Mitsetse miviri ine ma area akasiyana uye slope imwechete
y-m-25-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga nzira yechirevo kudivi rakapesana (kubva ku slope kuenda ku area).
y-m-25-06.s.s1.o.b: Mitsetse miviri ine area imwechete uye slope imwechete
y-m-25-06.s.s1.r.b: Wakasiya kuti kuwana muenzaniso apo chirevo chinoshanda kunosimbisa chirevo chete.
y-m-25-06.s.s1.o.c: Mitsetse miviri ine area imwechete uye ma slope akasiyana
y-m-25-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakaona kuti muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro echirevo uye unoputsa mhedziso i counterexample.
y-m-25-06.s.s1.o.d: Mitsetse miviri ine ma area akasiyana uye ma slope akasiyana
y-m-25-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakasiya kuti muenzaniso usingagutsi mamiriro echirevo (ma area akafanana) hausi kuedza.
y-m-25-06.s.s1.explain: Kuputsa chirevo chekuti 'kana A, saka B' chakarurama nguva dzose, unoda muenzaniso mumwe chete unogutsa A asi unoputsa B. Pano i mitsetse miviri ine area imwechete uye ma slope akasiyana.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mitsetse 3 ine triangle ine area 12 uye ma slope ese akasiyana. Pamutsetse mumwe nemumwe, isa x-intercept a ne y-intercept b. Padanho iri, a ne b zvose i positive.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora se expression kuti mutengo upi unogadzirwa kubva ku a ne b unofanira kuenzana ne chii kuti area ive 12.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wagadzirisa a uye woshandura b, wobva watarisa iwe pachako kuti ma slope haapindirani.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Ma intercepts ese mbiri i positive.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b hazvisi zvose positive.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Area yetriangle (hafu yeproduct ye a ne b) haisi 12.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.explain: Muenzaniso: (4, 6), (6, 4), (3, 8). Ese ane area 12 asi ma slope akasiyana: −3/2, −2/3, −8/3. Saka chirevo chaHyeonu hachigari chakarurama.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora mhinduro yako kuchirevo chaHyeonu mumashoko 1 kana 2, uchishandisa mienzaniso iri pamusoro sehumbowo.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Unogona kushandisa ma intercepts emitsetse miviri yawakagadzira pamusoro sezvazviri.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tanga wanyora mushoko rimwe rekuti 'sei chirevo chaHyeonu chakaipa'.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa kuti mumienzaniso yawakapa, ma area akafanana uye ma slope akasiyana here?
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora uchiziva kuti muenzaniso mumwe wakakwana here?
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora kuti shoko rekuti 'nguva dzose' rinoputswa sei here?
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Chirevo chaHyeonu chakaipa. Semuenzaniso, kana a=4, b=6 area i 12, uye kana a=6, b=4 area i 12 zvakare, asi ma slope akasiyana.
y-m-25-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Hazvisi nguva dzose. Mutsetse une ma intercepts (4, 6) nemutsetse une ma intercepts (3, 8) ese ane area 12 asi ma slope akasiyana, saka i counterexample.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.prompt: Ikozvino chinja mamiriro. Mitsetse mingani ine slope −3/2 (inoverengwa: negative three halves) uye inoumba triangle ine area 12 nemaaxes maviri? Panguva ino hapana fungidziro yekuti ma intercepts maviri i positive.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mutsetse une slope −3/2 se y = −(3/2)x + k, uye uwane kwainosangana nemaaxes maviri kana k i 6 uye kana k i −6.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.hint.1: Wana area yetriangle muzviitiko zvembiri zvese uye utarise kana i 12.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.o.a: Mumwe: mutsetse une ma intercepts (4, 0) ne (0, 6) chete, uye hapana mumwe
y-m-25-06.s.s3.r.a: Wakatora fungidziro yema intercepts i positive kubva padanho rakapfuura sezvayakaita.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.o.b: Mbiri: mutsetse mumwe une ma intercepts i positive uye mumwe une ma intercepts i negative
y-m-25-06.s.s3.r.b: Hauna kusiya kuti mutsetse une ma intercepts i negative une area imwechetewo.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.o.c: Hapana: nekuti kana slope yasimbiswa, area yasimbiswawo
y-m-25-06.s.s3.r.c: Wakafunga kuti slope oga inosimbisa area.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.o.d: Mitsetse isingaperi: mutsetse wose unogoneka chero slope iri imwechete
y-m-25-06.s.s3.r.d: Hauna kufunga kuti mamiriro e area anoderedza kuita mitsetse mingani.
y-m-25-06.s.s3.explain: Mutsetse une slope −3/2 une chimiro y = −(3/2)x + k. Area ipapo i k²/3, uye kuti ive 12, k i 6 kana −6. Saka kune mbiri: y = −(3/2)x + 6 ne y = −(3/2)x − 6.

y-m-25-02.title: Tinoda kuyera chii kuti tifanotaure hurefu hwe spring?
y-m-25-02.topic: Kutara equation ye linear function: marekodhi ekuyera akakwana here, uye renji apo fanotaura inogona kuvimbwa
y-m-25-02.goal: Tonga kuti ruzivo rupi runodiwa kutara equation ye linear function, uye utaure kuti fanotaura yakagadzirwa neequation iyoyo inogona kuvimbwa kusvika papi.
y-m-25-02.material: Mukirasi ye science unoita experiment yekuchengetedza ma weight pa spring nekuyera hurefu hwose hwe spring. Ngatitii kurema kwema weight ndi x g uye hurefu hwose hwe spring ndi y cm. Zvinozivikanwa kuti kune spring iyi, kusvika ku250 g, y ilinear function ye x, y=ax+b (a inhamba isiri zero). Fungidzira kuti kuyera kwose kwakaitwa pa spring imwe chete pasina kukanganisa. Mina akagamuchira seti dzemarekodhi akayerwa nemapoka akati wandei.
y-m-25-02.thinking.1: Kusarudza iwe pachako kuti ruzivo rupi rwunodiwa
y-m-25-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva a ne b mu linear function y=ax+b
y-m-25-02.prereq.1: Kuverenga coordinates dzepoinzi pa coordinate plane
y-m-25-02.s.s1.prompt: Pakati pemarekodhi aya pazasi, sarudza ose apo, uchishandisa rekodhi iyoyo oga, equation y=ax+b ye spring iyi inogona kutarwa kuva imwe chete. Hapana chinozivikanwa kunze kwerekodhi imwe neimwe.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kune seti imwe neimwe yemarekodhi, verenga kuti pane ma weight akasiyana mangani.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora marekodhi eseti imwe neimwe samapoinzi (weight, hurefu) uye fungidzira kuti mitsetse yakananga mingani inopfuura napamapoinzi iwayo ose.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.o.a: Nyaya apo pane rekodhi imwe chete, 10 cm pa0 g
y-m-25-02.s.s1.r.a: Ungasaona kuti kana pane poinzi imwe chete, mitsetse yakawanda inopfuura napayo.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.o.b: 12 cm pa50 g, 14 cm pa100 g
y-m-25-02.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakatarisa kuti hurefu hunochinja zvakadini pakati pema weight maviri akasiyana.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.o.c: Rekodhi inoyera 14 cm pa100 g kaviri (14 cm nguva mbiri dzose)
y-m-25-02.s.s1.r.c: Uku kutonga kwakaona kuyera kwakawanda sekwakakwana. Hauna kuverenga kuti pane ma weight akasiyana mangani.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.o.d: 12 cm pa50 g, 16 cm pa150 g
y-m-25-02.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaona kuti marekodhi panzvimbo mbiri dziri kure muweight anoratidzawo shanduko.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.o.e: 10 cm pa0 g, 18 cm pa200 g
y-m-25-02.s.s1.r.e: Uku kutonga kwakaona kuti hurefu pasina weight hwakasungirirwa hunogona kushandiswawo sepoinzi imwe.
y-m-25-02.s.s1.explain: Equation ye linear function inotarwa kuva imwe chete kana pane marekodhi pamapoinzi maviri ane x dzakasiyana. Kana pane poinzi imwe chete, kana weight imwe chete yakayerwa kakawanda, mitsetse yakawanda inopfuura napapoinzi iyoyo, saka haigoni kutarwa.
y-m-25-02.s.s2.prompt: Equation imwe chete y=0.04x+10 yakabuda kubva pamarekodhi e b, d, ne e (x mu g, y mu cm). Manual ye spring inoti 'kusvika ku250 g, hurefu ilinear function yekurema'. Kana Mina akaisa x=300 mu equation iyi ndokufanotaura y=22 cm, fanotaura iyi inofanira kubatwa sei?
y-m-25-02.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa renji yema weight akanyorwa mu manual nekurema kwaunoda kufanotaura.
y-m-25-02.s.s2.hint.1: Funga zvakaparadzana interval yakasimbiswa neexperiment kana manual neinterval isina kusimbiswa.
y-m-25-02.s.s2.o.a: Ndakaverenga nequation, saka zvakanaka kunyora kuti hurefu pa300 g ndi22 cm
y-m-25-02.s.s2.r.a: Wakavimba nekukosha sezvakaita usina kutarisa renji apo equation inoshanda.
y-m-25-02.s.s2.o.b: Inopfuura renji iri mu manual, saka ndinofunga kuti equation iyi haigoni kushandiswa zvachose
y-m-25-02.s.s2.r.b: Wakarasa equation yose usina kuparadzanisa makosha ari kunze kwerenji nemakosha ari mukati merenji.
y-m-25-02.s.s2.o.c: Taura kuti kunze kwe250 g hapana chivimbiso, saka 22 cm ifanotaura chete
y-m-25-02.s.s2.r.c: Uri kutaura zvakaparadzana nezverenji apo equation yakasimbiswa neapo isina.
y-m-25-02.s.s2.o.d: Inongopfuura zvishoma pa250 g, saka kukanganisa kudiki uye zvakanaka kunyora 22 cm
y-m-25-02.s.s2.r.d: Wakafunga kuti kutsauka kudiki kwakanaka, asi hapana hwaro hwakapiwa hwazvo.
y-m-25-02.s.s2.explain: Equation inovimbiswa mukati merenji yakasimbiswa chete. Kukosha kunopfuura 250 g ifanotaura chete pasi pemamiriro ekuti 'kana equation iyi ichiramba ichishanda'. Kumakosha ari mukati merenji (semuenzaniso, 120 g) unogona kufanotaura neequation.
y-m-25-02.s.s3.prompt: Boka rine seti yekutanga yemarekodhi (rekodhi imwe chete, 10 cm pa0 g) rinogona kuita kuyera kumwe chete kwakawanda. Nyora kuti chii chekuyera kuti equation itarwe, uye kuti nei kuyera uku kuchibatsira.
y-m-25-02.s.s3.hint.0: Funga kuti chii chinochinja kana ukayera paweight yakasiyana neweight yepoinzi yaunotoita.
y-m-25-02.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora musiyano weweight nemusiyano wehurefu wemapoinzi maviri.
y-m-25-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Weight yaunoyera nyowani yakasiyana ne0 g here?
y-m-25-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora chikonzero chekuti nei kuyera uku kuchibatsira here?
y-m-25-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora zvakananga kuti ndezvipi chaizvo zvinodiwa (weight nehurefu) here?
y-m-25-02.s.s3.model.0: Chengeta weight isiri 0 g, semuenzaniso 100 g, uye uyere hurefu. Ipapo pane mapoinzi maviri, saka ndinogona kutsvaga kuti hurefu hunowedzera zvakadini kana weight ichiwedzera, ndiko kuti, slope.
y-m-25-02.s.s3.model.1: Chengeta imwe weight yakawanda uye uyere hurefu paweight isiri 0 g. Kuenzanisa kuti hurefu hwakachinja zvakadini nekuti weight yakachinja zvakadini kunondiudza slope.

y-m-25-07.title: a ne b dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzipi kuti mutsetse usapfuure second quadrant?
y-m-25-07.topic: Ma quadrant anopfuurwa negraph ye linear function, nemasimbi e slope ne y-intercept
y-m-25-07.goal: Wana mamiriro ekuti mutsetse usapfuure second quadrant uchishandisa masimbi e slope ne y-intercept, pasina kusiya muganhu (chiitiko apo y-intercept i 0).
y-m-25-07.material: Graph ye linear function y=ax+b i mutsetse (a i nhamba isiri 0). a i slope uye b i y-intercept. Second quadrant i nzvimbo yemapoinzi ane x-coordinate i negative uye y-coordinate i positive. Mapoinzi ari pa x-axis kana y-axis haasi emu quadrant ipi neipi.
y-m-25-07.prereq.0: Zvinoreva slope ne y-intercept mu linear function y=ax+b
y-m-25-07.prereq.1: Nzvimbo dze quadrants (second quadrant: x<0, y>0)
y-m-25-07.s.s1.prompt: Pakati pemitsetse inotevera, sarudza yese isingapfuuri second quadrant.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.hint.0: Pa equation imwe neimwe, verenga kuti y i chii kana x i −1 ne −10.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga nzvimbo apo y inova positive kana x i negative.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakayeuka nzvimbo yemutsetse une slope i positive ne y-intercept i negative.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti kana y-intercept i negative, mutsetse unoenda kumusoro kuruboshwe unodzivisawo second quadrant.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiya kuti kana y-intercept i positive, kunyange uchienda kuruboshwe, uchiri kumusoro.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga kuti mutsetse unopfuura origin hapfuuri quadrant ipi neipi.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.r.e: Unoziva kuti kunyange mutsetse unopfuura origin unopfuura peya imwe chete ye quadrants.
y-m-25-07.s.s1.explain: Second quadrant i nzvimbo x < 0, y > 0. Kune y = 3x − 2 ne y = 2x, y i negative (kana 0) kana x i negative, saka havapindi munzvimbo iyi. Kune vamwe, y inova positive kumwe kune x i negative.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira (a, b) 3 dzakasiyana dze linear functions y = ax + b dzisingapfuuri second quadrant. a i slope uye b i y-intercept.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ita slope i positive, chinja y-intercept, uye utarise kana y ichiva positive pa x = −1 ne −10.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.hint.1: Edza chiitiko apo y-intercept i 0 nechiitiko apo i negative zvakaparadzana.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Neslope iyi, y inova positive kumwe kune x i diki zvakakwana, kana kuti hazvisi linear function. Tarisa zvakare simbi ye slope.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Y-intercept i hombe, saka kunyange kuruboshwe zvishoma pamusoro pe y-axis, y i positive. Tarisa zvakare range ye y-intercept.
y-m-25-07.s.s2.explain: Muenzaniso: (3, −2), (2, 0), (0.5, −4). Kana slope i positive uye y-intercept i 0 kana kushoma, mutsetse unopfuura first ne third quadrants chete (ne fourth quadrant zvakare kana y-intercept i negative).
y-m-25-07.s.s3.prompt: Mudzidzi akapfupisa mhedzisiro iri pamusoro nezvikonzero. Sarudza mutsetse wakaipa (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga ne 1 sezvadzakaonekwa pascreen).
y-m-25-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa mutsetse une b = 0 (semuenzaniso, y = 2x) pane nzvimbo apo x i negative.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga muenzaniso pakati peaya awakagadzira mudanho 2 usingabvumirani nekupfupisa uku.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.0: Kana a < 0, y inova positive kumwe kune x i diki zvakakwana, saka mutsetse unopfuura second quadrant. Saka a inofanira kuva > 0.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.1: Kana a > 0 ne b > 0, ipapo kufamba zvishoma kuruboshwe kubva papoinzi (0, b), y i positive, saka inopfuura second quadrant.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.2: Kana b = 0 inopfuura origin, asi muchiitiko ichi hapana y-intercept, saka b < 0 chete inogoneka.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.line.3: Kupfupisa: haipfuuri second quadrant chete kana a > 0 ne b < 0.
y-m-25-07.s.s3.explain: I mitsetse 3 ne 4. Mutsetse unopfuura origin une y-intercept zvakare, i 0 (b = 0). Kana a > 0 ne b = 0, mutsetse uyu hapfuuri second quadrant. Saka kupfupisa i a > 0 ne b ≤ 0.

y-m-25-01.title: Zvirongwa zvekurenda bhasikoro: chipi chinodhura zvishoma?
y-m-25-01.topic: Kushandisa linear functions: nguva apo magirafu emapurani maviri emitengo anosangana
y-m-25-01.goal: Enzanisa mamodel maviri e linear function (mitengo) uye utaure, nezvikonzero, kuti kuti rinhi ririna kunaka kunogona kuenderana nenguva yekushandisa.
y-m-25-01.material: Chiteshi chekurenda mabhasikoro epaki chine mapurani maviri emitengo. Purani (가) inobhadharisa mutengo wekutanga we1000원 pakutanga uye wozonyorera 100원 mhedzi paminitsi rega rega rekushandisa. Purani (나) haina mutengo wekutanga uye inobhadharisa 150원 paminitsi rega rega rekushandisa. Nguva yekushandisa inoyerwa chaizvo muminitsi (pasina kurunga kumusoro kana kudzika), uye kana nguva yekushandisa i x maminitsi (x i0 kana kupfuura), mutengo i y원.
y-m-25-01.prereq.0: Zvinoreva slope ne y-intercept mu linear function y=ax+b (ukuru hwegiredhi 8)
y-m-25-01.prereq.1: Kuisa kukosha kwe x mukutaura kana tebhura kuwana y
y-m-25-01.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Panhanho yega yega, sarudza pfungwa yakakodzera zvikuru uchishandisa zvinozivikanwa zvino chete, uye kana ruzivo rutsva rwabuda, sarudza kuchengeta kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kuti mutengo unowedzera zvakadini kana nguva yawedzera ne1 miniti papurani imwe neimwe.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzika nguva dzakawanda uye uverenge mitengo yemapurani maviri padivi nedivi.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Zvose zvinozivikanwa zvino mutengo wekutanga nemutengo paminitsi wemapurani maviri. Hatisati taziva kuti Minji achatasva bhasikoro kwenguva yakareba sei.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Purani ipi ichava inodhura zvishoma kuna Minji? Sarudza pfungwa dzinokodzera nezvinozivikanwa zvino chete (pfungwa dzinopfuura imwe dzinogona kukodzera).
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana ukataura 'nguva dzose' usingazive nguva yekushandisa, uri kutaura kunyange nyaya dzausina kuongorora. Mutengo wekutanga nemutengo paminitsi zvinodiwa nemativi akapesana, saka unogona kufungidzira kuti zvinogona kuenderana nenguva.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: (가), ine mutengo mudiki paminitsi, inogara ichidhura zvishoma
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Iyi pfungwa yakatarisa mutengo paminitsi chete isingafungi mutengo wekutanga.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinoita se(나) kushanya pfupi uye (가) kushanya kurefu, asi tinofanira kuverenga kuti tizive
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakafungidzira mushure mekuona kuti mutengo wekutanga nemutengo paminitsi zvinodiwa nepurani yakapesana imwe neimwe.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: (나), isina mutengo wekutanga, inogara ichidhura zvishoma
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Iyi pfungwa yakatarisa mutengo wekutanga chete isingafungi mutengo paminitsi.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kana tisingazive nguva yekushandisa, hatigoni kusarudza kuti ndeipi inodhura zvishoma
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakangwarira kunomira pamhedziso kana ruzivo rusina kukwana.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Minji anoti achatasva kwemaminitsi 10. Mitengo i(가) 100×10+1000=2000원 ne(나) 150×10=1500원.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sarudza zvinokodzera sezvinogona kutaurwa neruzivo urwu (zvinopfuura chimwe zvinogona kukodzera).
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ruzivo urwu harushandure zvakanyanya kutonga kwako kwekutanga. Zvino une humbowo hwekuti (나) inodhura zvishoma pamaminitsi 10, asi chiyero chinosvikwa nehumbowo uhwu chiri padhuze nemaminitsi 10 chete.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Pamaminitsi 10, (나) inodhura zvishoma ne500원. Pakutasva kurefu hatigoni kuziva kubva pakuverenga uku chete
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uri kuona kuti kana kuenzanisa panguva imwe kunofambira kunguva dzimwe kunofanira kuongororwa wega.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: (나) inodhura zvishoma pamaminitsi 10, saka (나) inodhura zvishoma panguva ipi neipi
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakataura nyaya dzose kubva pamuenzaniso mumwe.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: (나) inodhura zvishoma pamaminitsi 10, saka kuti kutasva kupfupi, (가) inova nani
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafunga zvakapesana nechokwadi chekuti kuti kutasva kupfupi, mugove unotorwa nemutengo wekutanga unova mukuru.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kana tikatarisa maminitsi 10 chete, tinogona kurudzira (나), uye kana nguva ichichinja tinofanira kuenzanisa zvakare
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakapedzisa chete kusvika pahumbowo hwazvino uchisiya zvimwe zvakavhurika.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Iyi itebhura yemitengo iri pabhodhi rechiziviso rechiteshi. Maminitsi 20: (가) 3000원, (나) 3000원 / maminitsi 30: (가) 4000원, (나) 4500원.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana Minji ave kuronga kutasva kwemaminitsi 40, ndeipi inodhura zvishoma uye ne marii? Sarudza inokodzera zvikuru, uchienzanisa nekutonga kwako kwekutanga.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Pamaminitsi 40, (가) i5000원 ne(나) i6000원. Pamaminitsi 20 mitengo miviri yakaenzana; pakutasva kupfupi (나) inodhura zvishoma, uye pakutasva kurefu (가) inodhura zvishoma.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: (나) inodhura zvishoma ne1000원. (나) yaidhura zvishoma pamaminitsi 10, saka inoramba yakadaro
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Zvinoita sewakashandisa musiyano we500원 wemaminitsi 30 mutebhura kumaminitsi 40 sezvawakaita. Kana ukaverenga mutengo wemaminitsi 40 zvakananga, wakasiyana.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: (가) inodhura zvishoma ne1000원. Mushure memaminitsi 20, inodhura zvishoma inochinja
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakaverenga kuti purani inodhura zvishoma inochinja padhuze nenguva apo mitengo yakaenzana.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti yakaenzana pamaminitsi 20 kunguva dzimwe.
y-m-25-01.s.s1.reflect: Pamaminitsi 10 (나) yaidhura zvishoma, uye pamaminitsi 40 (가) yaidhura zvishoma. Panzvimbo pekutaura 'nguva dzose' kubva pakuenzanisa panguva imwe, kana ukawana poinzi umo purani inodhura zvishoma inochinja (nguva apo mitengo miviri inova yakaenzana), unogona kutaura uchisanganisa mamiriro.
y-m-25-01.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yaMinji inodawo kushandisa chiteshi chimwe chete asi haisati yasarudza nguva yekushandisa. Nyora kurudziro ine mamiriro nezvekuti purani ipi yaizova yakanaka kusarudza.
y-m-25-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga mutsara patebhura yebhodhi rechiziviso umo mitengo miviri yakaenzana.
y-m-25-01.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga kamwe panguva pfupi kupfuura iyoyo uye kamwe panguva refu kupfuura iyoyo, uzvishandure kuita mitsara.
y-m-25-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura nguva apo mapurani maviri anova akaenzana senhamba here?
y-m-25-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora usina kusiya kuti ndeipi inodhura zvishoma pakutasva kupfupi nekurefu here?
y-m-25-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakadzivisa mashoko akasimba sa 'nguva dzose' here?
y-m-25-01.s.s2.model.0: Kana ukatasva kwemaminetsi anopfuura 20 pasi, (나) inodhura shoma, uye kana ukatasva kwemaminetsi anopfuura 20, (가) inodhura shoma. Pamaminetsi 20 chaizvo dzose mbiri ndi3000 won, dzakafanana.
y-m-25-01.s.s2.model.1: Kana uchitasva kwemaminetsi 20 kana pasi, sarudza (나), uye kana uchitasva kwemaminetsi anopfuura 20, sarudza (가). Pamaminetsi 20 mitengo yakafanana, saka chero ipi inokwana.

y-m-25-03.title: Equation inopfuura napamapoinzi maviri ose: tinogona kuivimba here?
y-m-25-03.topic: Equation yemutsetse unopfuura napamapoinzi maviri: kuzvimirira kwekutarisa, nekukanganisa mumhinduro
y-m-25-03.goal: Ongorora kuti kutarisa kunozvimirira neruzivo rwakashandiswa kugadzira equation here, tsvaga mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro, uye ugadzire mapoinzi ari pa equation yakagadziriswa.
y-m-25-03.material: Minsu akaedza kunyora mutsetse unopfuura napamapoinzi maviri A(2, 3) ne B(6, 11) pa coordinate plane se equation yefomu y=ax+b. Equation yawakawana Minsu ndi y=(1/2)x+2. Minsu anoti akapedza kutarisa nekuti 'ndakaisa poinzi A(2, 3), (1/2)×2+2=3, saka yakarurama'.
y-m-25-03.prereq.0: Zvinoreva slope a mu linear function y=ax+b
y-m-25-03.prereq.1: Nzira yekutarisa nekuisa coordinates dzepoinzi mu equation kuti uone kuti inoshanda here
y-m-25-03.s.s1.prompt: Equation yawakawana Minsu ndi y=(1/2)x+2 (inoverengwa: y inoenzana nehafu x kuwedzera 2), uye anoti yakashanda kana akaisa poinzi A(2, 3). Unogona kuva nechokwadi kuti equation yakarurama kubva pazvo oga here? Sarudza kutonga kunokodzera zvakanyanya.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rangarira kuti ndeipi pamapoinzi A ne B yainge yashandiswa naMinsu, uye sei, pakugadzira equation.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti kutarisa kune zvinoreva chete kana kwaitwa neruzivo rusina kushandiswa kugadzira equation here.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.o.a: Yakashanda pa A, saka unogona kuva nechokwadi kuti equation yakarurama uye hapana chikonzero chekutarisa zvakawanda
y-m-25-03.s.s1.r.a: Hauna kufunga kuti poinzi yakashandiswa kutarisa inopindirana neruzivo rwakashandiswa kugadzira equation here.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.o.b: A ipoinzi yakashandiswa kugadzira equation, saka unofanira kuisawo B(6, 11)
y-m-25-03.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga kuti kutarisa kune zvinoreva chete kana kwaitwa neruzivo rusina kushandiswa kugadzira equation.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.o.c: Yakashanda pa A, asi inofanira kuva isina kururama pa B, saka equation inofanira kurasirwa
y-m-25-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakataura kuti haina kururama usati waiisa.
y-m-25-03.s.s1.explain: Zvinogona kuva zvakajairika kuti ishande papoinzi yakashandiswa kugadzira equation. Unogona kuziva kuti equation inopfuura napamapoinzi maviri ose chete nekutarisa nepoinzi isati yashandiswa (kana nenzira imwe).
y-m-25-03.s.s2.prompt: Kana B(6, 11) yakaiswa, equation yaMinsu yakaratidzwa kuva isina kururama. Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaMinsu (nhamba dzemitsara dzinotanga ku1 sezvadzinoonekwa pascreen).
y-m-25-03.s.s2.hint.0: Usati wadzokorora kuverenga kwemutsara mumwe nemumwe, shanda shure kubva pachokwadi chekuti kuisa B kunoratidza kuti haina kururama.
y-m-25-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga iwe pachako huwandu hunowedzera x nehuwandu hunowedzera y pakati pemapoinzi maviri, uye uenzanise nemutsara 2.
y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.0: Ngatitii equation yemutsetse unopfuura napa A(2, 3) ne B(6, 11) ndi y = ax + b.
y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.1: Slope a = (kuwedzera kwe x) ÷ (kuwedzera kwe y) = (6−2) ÷ (11−3) = 4/8 = 1/2
y-m-25-03.s.s2.line.2: Kuisa A(2, 3) mu y = (1/2)x + b kunopa 3 = 1 + b, saka b = 2
y-m-25-03.s.s2.explain: Ndiwo mutsara 2. Slope ndi (kuwedzera kwe y) ÷ (kuwedzera kwe x), saka (11−3) ÷ (6−2) = 8/4 = 2. Mitsara 3 ne4 ndiyo mhedzisiro yekuenderera ne slope isina kururama. Equation yakarurama ndi y = 2x − 1, uye kana B(6, 11) yaiswa, 12 − 1 = 11 inoshanda.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.prompt: Tsvaga mapoinzi 3 akasiyana ari pa equation yakarurama uye asiri A kana B, uye uaise se (x, y). Zvisinei, x iri kubva ku−10 kusvika ku10.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tsvaga kuti y inowedzera zvakadini kana x ichiwedzera ne4 kubva ku A kuenda ku B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kutanga kubva ku A, tsvaga mapoinzi rimwe rimwe uchishandisa kuti y inochinja zvakadini nguva imwe neimwe x ichiwedzera ne1.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Poinzi iyi iri pamutsetse unopfuura napa A ne B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Poinzi iyi haisi pamutsetse unopfuura napa A ne B. Enzanisa ratio yekuwedzera kwe x kukuwedzera kwe y kubva ku A kuenda kupoinzi iyi neya AB.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.ok.c2: Ipoinzi yakasiyana ne A ne B.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.fail.c2: Ipoinzi imwe chete ne A kana B. Tsvaga poinzi yakasiyana.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.fail.c3: x haisi kubva ku−10 kusvika ku10.
y-m-25-03.s.s3.explain: Muenzaniso: (0, −1), (1, 1), (4, 7). Dzose mapoinzi ari pa y = 2x − 1. Pane mutsetse mumwe chete unopfuura napamapoinzi maviri, saka neequation yakarurama, x ipi neipi inopa poinzi iri pamutsetse umwe chete. Poinzi (4, 4) iri pa equation yaMinsu y = (1/2)x + 2 haisi pamutsetse uyu.

y-m-25-04.title: Kunyangwe ma equation maviri aine chimiro chakasiyana, pane solution imwe chete here?
y-m-25-04.topic: Ma solution e simultaneous linear equation nenzvimbo dzemitsetse miviri (solution imwe, hapana, dzisingaperi)
y-m-25-04.goal: Nzwisisa kuti ma linear equation maviri anoita sezvakasiyana anogona kuva mutsetse mumwe chete, ronga nyaya apo huwandu hwema solution hunoenderana ne constant, uye gadzira iwe pachako ma equation emutsetse mumwe chete.
y-m-25-04.material: Mu simultaneous equation, linear equation ax+by=c inogona kudhirowa semutsetse pa coordinate plane (a ne b hazvisi 0 zvose). Kana mitsetse miviri ikasangana papoinzi imwe, pane peya imwe ye solution; kana isingasangani, hapana solution; uye kana ikapindirana zvizere, pane ma solution asingaperi. Peya (x, y) inogutsa ma equation ose maviri inonzi solution ye simultaneous equation.
y-m-25-04.prereq.0: Kuona ma solution e linear equation ax+by=c samapoinzi pa coordinate plane
y-m-25-04.s.s1.prompt: Mapeya (x, y) mangani anogutsa ose equation yekutanga 2x − y = −1 (inoverengwa: 2x kubvisa y inoenzana ne negative 1) ne equation yechipiri 4x − 2y = −2?
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakare equation imwe neimwe mufomu y = (slope)x + (y-intercept) uye uzvinyore padivi pemumwe.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.hint.1: Isa x = 0 ne x = 1 mu equation dzose mbiri, tsvaga makosha e y, uye uenzanise.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.a: Pane peya imwe chete. Nekuti ma equation maviri ane maumbirwo akasiyana
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kana ma equation achiita sezvakasiyana, mitsetse yakasiyana.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.b: Hapana peya. Nekuti mitsetse miviri ine slope imwe chete, saka inoenderana
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa chete kuti ma slope akaenzana uye hauna kuenzanisa ma y-intercept.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.o.c: Pane dzisingaperi. Nekuti ma equation maviri anomirira mutsetse mumwe chete
y-m-25-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakaona kuti kunyangwe chitarisiko chakasiyana, vanogona kuva mutsetse mumwe chete.
y-m-25-04.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaparadzanisa mativi ose maviri e 4x − 2y = −2 ne2, unowana 2x − y = −1. Ma equation maviri ndiwo mutsetse mumwe chete, saka poinzi yose iri pamutsetse isolution.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.prompt: Chengeta equation yekutanga sezvayakaita, uye ushandure equation yechipiri kuita 4x − 2y = c (c iconstant). Huwandu hwema solution hunochinja sei zvichienderana nekukosha kwe c?
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isa nhamba mbiri (semuenzaniso, −2, 0, 4) pa c uye uenzanise ma y-intercept emitsetse miviri.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.hint.1: Paradzanisa nyaya apo mitsetse miviri ine slope imwe chete kuita ine y-intercept imwe chete neine y-intercept dzakasiyana.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.a: Chero c iri chii, pane ma solution asingaperi. Nekuti ma coefficient akafanana
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.a: Wakatarisa ma coefficient e equation chete uye hauna kufunga constant term c.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.b: Pane ma solution asingaperi kune c imwe chete, uye kune dzimwe hapana solution
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.b: Wakaona kuti kana c ichichinja, mutsetse unofamba wakaenderana.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.c: Hapana solution kune c imwe chete chete, uye kune dzimwe c pane peya imwe imwe
y-m-25-04.s.s2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti kana ma slope akaenzana, mitsetse inosangana munyaya dzose.
y-m-25-04.s.s2.o.d: Kana c isiri 0, pane peya imwe nguva dzose, uye kana iri 0, hapana
y-m-25-04.s.s2.explain: 4x − 2y = c ndi y = 2x − c/2, uye equation yekutanga ndi y = 2x + 1. Ma slope akafanana, saka ndiwo mutsetse mumwe chete chete kana c = −2, uye kune dzimwe c dzinoenderana uye hadzipindirani, saka hapana solution.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira equation yechipiri ax + by = c inomirira mutsetse mumwe chete ne equation yekutanga 2x − y = −1. Kuti chitarisiko chisave chakafanana, a haifaniri kuva 2, uye isa ma equation 3 akasiyana se (a, b, c).
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora ma coefficient 2, −1, −1 e equation yekutanga uye uaise padivi pe a, b, c ye equation yechipiri.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti ma equation maviri anopfuura napamapoinzi akafanana kana x = 0 nekana y = 0 here.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c1: Ratio yema coefficient e x ne y yakafanana ne equation yekutanga, saka slope yakafanana.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c1: Ratio yema coefficient e x ne y yakasiyana ne equation yekutanga, saka slope yakasiyana.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c2: Constant term iri mu ratio imwe chete zvakare, saka mitsetse inopindirana.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c2: Ratio yema coefficient yakarurama asi constant term haisi mu ratio iyoyo, saka mutsetse unoenderana wakasiyana.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.ok.c3: Chitarisiko chayo chakasiyana ne equation yekutanga.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.fail.c3: a ndi2 kana 0. Chitarisiko chayo chakafanana ne equation yekutanga, kana haiiti mutsetse.
y-m-25-04.s.s3.explain: Muenzaniso: (4, −2, −2), (−2, 1, 1), (6, −3, −3). Kana nhamba nhatu dze equation yechipiri dziri nhamba nhatu (2, −1, −1) dze equation yekutanga dzakawedzerwa nenhamba imwe chete, ma equation maviri ndiwo mutsetse mumwe chete. Kana kunyangwe nhamba imwe ikatsauka pa ratio iyoyo, haisi mutsetse mumwe chete.

y-m-25-05.title: Iya ine nhamba yeslope huru inomhanya zvakanyanya here?
y-m-25-05.topic: Kuverenga slope ye graph: kuenzanisa ma graph maviri ane zvikamu zvakasiyana
y-m-25-05.goal: Nzwisisa kuti slope inofanira kuverengwa pamwe chete nezvikamu zvayo, uye enzanisa ma graph maviri ane zvikamu zvakasiyana nekuashandura kuita zvikamu zvakafanana.
y-m-25-05.material: Doyun naSeoa mumwe nemumwe akafamba uye akadhirowa marekodhi avo se graph. Graph yaDoyun ine nguva (maminetsi) pa horizontal axis nechinhambwe chakafambwa (m) pa vertical axis, uye imutsetse wakananga unopfuura napa origin (0, 0) napapoinzi (10, 700). Graph yaSeoa ine nguva (maawa) pa horizontal axis nechinhambwe chakafambwa (km) pa vertical axis, uye imutsetse wakananga unopfuura napa origin napapoinzi (2, 10).
y-m-25-05.thinking.2: Kuziva fungidziro inoita kuti kuenzanisa kushande
y-m-25-05.prereq.0: Zvinoreva slope a mu graph ye linear function y=ax
y-m-25-05.s.s1.prompt: Doyun akati, 'Slope ye graph yangu ndi70 uye yaSeoa ndi5, saka ndinomhanya zvikuru!' Ungatonga sei chirevo ichi?
y-m-25-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kune graph imwe neimwe, taura kuti vertical axis inowedzera zvakadini kana horizontal axis ichiwedzera ne1, pamwe chete nechikamu.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti zvikamu zvakanamatirwa kuma slope maviri zvakafanana here.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.a: Mayuniti emagraph maviri akasiyana, saka haagone kuenzaniswa nenhamba dzega
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga zvinoreva slope pamwe chete neyuniti yayo.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.b: Painonyanya kukura slope, ndipo painomhanya, saka Doyun, ane 70 yakakura kupfuura 5, anomhanya
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakaenzanisa hukuru hwenhamba chete usina kutarisa mayuniti.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.o.c: Painonyanya kudiki slope, ndipo painokurumidza kufukidza kureba kumwechete, saka Seoa anomhanya
y-m-25-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga hukama pakati peslope nekumhanya kuri kudivi rakapesana.
y-m-25-05.s.s1.explain: Slope i huwandu hunowedzera vertical axis kana horizontal axis ichiwedzera ne 1. Doyun anofamba 70 m paminetsi uye Seoa anofamba 5 km paawa, saka kana mayuniti akasiyana, haagone kuenzaniswa nenhamba dzega.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.prompt: Kana ukashandura kufamba kwaDoyun kuita mayuniti akafanana negraph yaSeoa (maawa pa horizontal axis, km pa vertical axis), Doyun anofamba d km mumaawa t. Isa mapeya (t, d) 3 akasiyana anoenderana nehukama uhwu. Zvisinei, 0 < t ≤ 3.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.hint.0: Wana kureba kunofambwa naDoyun paminetsi 1, wobva wawana kureba kunofambwa paawa 1.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.hint.1: Shandura kureba kwawakawana kubva ku m kuenda ku km, isa nguva shoma, uye uverenge kureba.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.fail.c1: t haisi hombe kupfuura 0 uye 3 kana kushoma.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Haienderani nekufamba kwaDoyun. Doyun anofamba 700 m muminetsi 10, uye awa 1 i maminetsi 60 uye 1 km i 1000 m.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.explain: Doyun anofamba 700 m muminetsi 10, ndiko kuti, 70 m paminetsi 1. Paawa 1 (maminetsi 60), i 4200 m = 4.2 km, saka mapoinzi sa (1, 4.2), (2, 8.4), (0.5, 2.1) ese anoenderana.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Mumashoko 1 kana 2, nyora kuti wakawana sei (t, d).
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mushoko rimwe hukama pakati peminetsi 1 neawa 1.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Zvadaro nyora hukama pakati pe m ne km.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Unogona kuona maitiro ekushandura yuniti yenguva here?
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Unogona kuona maitiro ekushandura yuniti yekureba here?
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutevera kwakabva mutengo wekupedzisira here?
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.model.0: I 700 m muminetsi 10, saka i 70 m paminetsi 1. Awa 1 i maminetsi 60, saka 70×60=4200 m, uye 1000 m i 1 km, saka i 4.2 km.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.model.1: 700 m i 0.7 km uye maminetsi 10 i 1/6 yeawa. Paawa 1, anofamba 0.7×6=4.2 km.
y-m-25-05.s.s2.because.model.2: 700 m muminetsi 10, saka mukumhanya paawa i 700*6=4200 m, ndiko kuti, 4.2 km/h.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.prompt: Zvinoreva kuti Doyun anofamba 4.2 km paawa uye Seoa anofamba 5 km paawa. Kuti kuenzanisa uku kuve nebasa, fungidziro ipi inodiwa zvachose?
y-m-25-05.s.s3.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, fungidzira kuti mamiriro iwayo haapo uye funga kana uchigona kutaura mutengo mumwe we 'ma km mangani paawa'.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ongorora rimwe nerimwe kana sarudzo imwe neimwe i ruzivo rwunodiwa kuwana kumhanya.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.o.a: Takayera kureba kwakafambwa nevaviri panguva imwechete
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kureba kwenguva imwechete kunofanira kuenzaniswa. Hazvidiwi kuenzanisa kumhanya.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.o.b: Vaviri vakafamba panzira imwechete munzira imwechete
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.b: Wakafunga kuti inofanira kuva nzira imwechete, asi chimiro chenzira hachina basa pakuenzanisa kumhanya.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.o.c: Vanhu vese vaviri vakafamba nekumhanya kwakatsiga
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.c: Wakaona kuti mugraph yemutsetse wakananga chete, slope inoenzana nekumhanya.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.o.d: Vaviri vakatanga panzvimbo imwechete panguva imwechete
y-m-25-05.s.s3.r.d: Wakafunga kuti nzvimbo dzekutanga dzinofanira kuva dzakafanana, asi kumhanya hakuna chekuita nenzvimbo yekutanga.
y-m-25-05.s.s3.explain: Kana graph i mutsetse wakananga, zvinoreva kuti kumhanya kwakatsiga, saka slope i kumhanya. Nguva imwechete, nzira imwechete, nenzvimbo yekutanga imwechete hazvidiwi.
